result.instructions: Tools for Rollbar, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which errors are most active in production in the last 24 hours?"; "Show me the stack trace of the newest occurrence of item 275123456."; "Mark the checkout error as resolved in version 2.14.3.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Rollbar data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run rollbar_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rollbar_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rollbar_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. rollbar_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rollbar_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the projects in the account. Needs an account access token. Rollbar API: GET /api/1/projects.

tools.name: rollbar_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one project: name, status and settings. Uses the configured project ID unless project_id is given. Rollbar API: GET /api/1/project/{project_id}.

tools.name: rollbar_list_environments
tools.title: List environments
tools.description: List the environments of the project (for example production or staging), 20 per page. Rollbar API: GET /api/1/environments.

tools.name: rollbar_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List error items (grouped occurrences) with their status, level, environment and counts. 100 per page. Use it to find what is failing. Rollbar API: GET /api/1/items.

environment.description: Only items in this environment, for example production.

query.description: Search text, as in the Rollbar Items search box.

is_snoozed.description: true = only snoozed items; false = leave them out.

tools.name: rollbar_get_item
tools.title: Get an item
tools.description: Get one item by its ID: title, status, level, counts and assignee. The ID is the id field of list results, not the project counter in the URL. Rollbar API: GET /api/1/item/{itemid}.

tools.name: rollbar_find_item
tools.title: Find an item by counter or UUID
tools.description: Find one item from the project counter (the number in a Rollbar item URL) or an occurrence UUID. Give one of them. Rollbar API: GET /api/1/item/?counter= or ?uuid=.

tools.name: rollbar_list_item_occurrences
tools.title: List occurrences of an item
tools.description: List the occurrences (single error events) of one item, newest first, 20 per page. Use them to read stack traces and request data. Rollbar API: GET /api/1/item/{item_id}/instances.

tools.name: rollbar_list_item_events
tools.title: List history of an item
tools.description: List the history of one item: comments, status, level and assignee changes. Pass type to filter, for example item_status_history. Rollbar API: GET /api/1/item/{item_id}/events.

type.description: One event type, for example item_comment or item_status_history.

tools.name: rollbar_list_deploys
tools.title: List deploys
tools.description: List deploys reported to the project, most recent first, 20 per page. Use it to link errors to releases. Rollbar API: GET /api/1/deploys.

tools.name: rollbar_get_deploy
tools.title: Get a deploy
tools.description: Get one deploy: environment, revision, user and time. Rollbar API: GET /api/1/deploy/{deploy_id}.

tools.name: rollbar_top_active_items
tools.title: Top active items
tools.description: List the most active items over the last hours, with their occurrence counts. A good first call to find the biggest problems. Rollbar API: GET /api/1/reports/top_active_items.

tools.name: rollbar_occurrence_counts
tools.title: Occurrence counts over time
tools.description: Count occurrences per time bucket (minute, hour or day, GMT), filtered by level, environment or item. Rollbar API: GET /api/1/reports/occurrence_counts.

tools.name: rollbar_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the teams of the account. Needs an account access token. Rollbar API: GET /api/1/teams.

tools.name: rollbar_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the account with their usernames and emails. Needs an account access token. Give email to look one user up. Rollbar API: GET /api/1/users.

email.description: Look up one user by email.

tools.name: rollbar_update_item
tools.title: Update an item
tools.description: Change an item: status (active, resolved or muted), level, title, resolved_in_version (when resolving) or assignee. Changes what the team sees, so confirm first. Needs a token with the write scope. Rollbar API: PATCH /api/1/item/{itemid}.

resolved_in_version.description: Release that fixes the item. Used with status resolved.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Rollbar
prompts.description: What you can do with Rollbar here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_the_most_active_errors
prompts.title: Find the most active errors
prompts.description: List the most active error items of the last hours, with their occurrence counts. Open one item to read its title, status and level.

prompts.name: read_the_stack_traces_of_an_error
prompts.title: Read the stack traces of an error
prompts.description: Find an item by its project counter or an occurrence UUID. List its occurrences, newest first, to read the stack traces and request data.

prompts.name: link_an_error_to_a_recent_deploy
prompts.title: Link an error to a recent deploy
prompts.description: List the recent deploys and open one to read its environment, revision and time. Count occurrences over time to see when an error began.

prompts.name: mark_an_error_resolved_in_a_version
prompts.title: Mark an error resolved in a version
prompts.description: Set an item to resolved and name the version that fixed it. The change shows to the whole team, so confirm it first.

prompts.name: review_the_history_of_an_item
prompts.title: Review the history of an item
prompts.description: List the history of an item: comments, status, level and assignee changes. List the teams of the account for context.
